__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.description:
The wizard looks old and senile, and yet he looks like a very powerful
wizard. He is equipped with fine clothing, and is wearing many fine
rings and bracelets.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.long_descr: A wizard walks around behind the counter, talking to himself.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.name: wizard

__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.description:
A fat, nice looking baker. But you can see that he has many scars on his
body.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.long_descr: The baker looks at you calmly, wiping flour from his face with one hand.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.name: baker

__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.description: A tall grocer, who moves two 200 pounds bag of flour around on his shoulders.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.long_descr: A grocer stands at the counter, with a slightly impatient look on his face.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.name: grocer

__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.description: A young weaponsmith, who still has lots to learn.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.long_descr: A weaponsmith.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.name: weaponsmith

__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.description:
An old but very strong armourer, he has made more armours in his
lifetime than you have ever seen.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.long_descr: An armourer stands here.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.name: armourer armorer

__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.description: Well COUNT your money!
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.long_descr: A thief, all dressed in black.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.name: thief

__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.description: This captain has killed more sharks than you have eaten peas.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.long_descr: A retired captain stands here, selling boats.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.name: captain

__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.description: He looks like a strong, fit sailor.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.long_descr: A sailor stands here, waiting to train you.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.name: sailor

__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.description: He is young and close-cropped and looks quite happy.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.long_descr: A pet shop boy is here, humming gently.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.name: boy

__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.description: He is fat and has a content although watchful look on his face.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.long_descr: The jeweller is standing behind the desk.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.name: jeweller

__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.description:
She looks as an honest, hard-working artisan who only just earns enough to
keep herself going.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.long_descr: The leather worker is sitting by the table, sewing a leather cap.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.name: leather worker

__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.description:
Big. Very big.
Stupid. Very stupid.

Hassan, the guardian of  the Temple of Mota, towers over you.  He's over 12
feet tall, every inch of it muscle. It would be a Bad Thing to commit a crime
in his presence.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.long_descr: Hassan is here, waiting to dispense some justice.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.name: hassan

__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.description:
Although retired from adventuring, the healer still lends a hand.
Type 'heal' to see a listing of spells.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.long_descr: A healer is here, selling spells.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.name: healer

__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.description:
Even though your guildmaster looks old and tired, you can clearly see the
vast amount of knowledge she possesses. She is wearing fine magic clothing,
and you notice that she is surrounded by a blue shimmering aura.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.long_descr: Your guildmaster is standing here.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.name: guildmaster master

__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.description:
You are in no doubt that this guildmaster is truly close to your god; he has
a peaceful, loving look. You notice that he is surrounded by a white aura.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.long_descr: Your guildmaster is standing here.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.name: guildmaster master

__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.description:
You realize that whenever your guildmaster moves, you fail to notice it:
the way of the true thief.  She is dressed in poor clothing, having
the appearance of a beggar.
human
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.long_descr: Your guildmaster is standing here.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.name: guildmaster master

__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.description:
This is your master. A short, strong dwarf with bulging muscles.  Several scars
across his body prove that he was using arms before you were born.  He
has a calm look on his face.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.long_descr: Your guildmaster is standing here.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.name: guildmaster master

__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.description:
He is an experienced mage who has specialized in the field of Combat Magic.
He is here to guard the Mage's Guild and his superior knowledge of offensive
as well as defensive spells make him a deadly opponent.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.long_descr: A sorcerer is guarding the entrance.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.name: sorcerer

__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.description:
He is a specially trained warrior belonging to the military order of the Faith.
His duty is to protect the faithful from persecution and infidel attacks and
his religious devotion combined with his superior skill makes him a deadly
opponent.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.long_descr: A knight templar is guarding the entrance.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.name: templar

__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.description:
He is a thief who has specialized in killing others as effectively as possible,
using all sorts of weapons.  His superior knowledge of how and where to use
them combined with his extraordinary stealth makes him a deadly opponent.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.long_descr: An assassin is guarding the entrance.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.name: assassin

__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.description:
He is an expert warrior who has attained knighthood through countless
chivalrous deeds.  His duty is to protect the Guild of Swordsmen and his
extreme skill combined with his experience in warfare makes him a deadly
opponent.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.long_descr: A knight is guarding the entrance.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.name: knight

__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.description: A tired looking Bartender who hates trouble in his bar.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.long_descr: A bartender watches you calmly, while he skillfully mixes a drink.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.name: bartender

__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.description: A tired looking waiter.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.long_descr: A waiter is going around from one place to another.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.name: waiter

__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.long_descr:
A man who in his young days was a famous sorcerer but now leads a quiet,
peaceful life as a waiter.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.name: waiter

__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.long_descr: A waiter who seems to have reached contact with God.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.name: waiter

__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.long_descr: A waiter who knows where all his customers keep their money.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.name: waiter

__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.long_descr: A waiter who easily could kill you, and still carry quite a few firebreathers.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.name: waiter

__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.description:
Filthy looks real, ehm, dirty. He likes to keep his costumers happy,
but do not mess with him or else he'll get upset.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.long_descr: Filthy is standing here, eager to serve you a special drink.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.name: filthy

__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.description: A big, strong, helpful, trustworthy guard.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.long_descr: A cityguard stands here.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.name: cityguard guard

__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.long_descr: A janitor is walking around, cleaning up.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.name: janitor

__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.description:
Fido is a small dog that has a foul smell and pieces of rotted meat hanging
around its teeth.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.long_descr: A beastly fido is here.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.name: fido dog

__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.description: He looks pretty mean.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.long_descr: A vagabond is here, looking for victims.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.name: vagabond

__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.description: A drunk who seems to be too happy, and to carry too much money.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.long_descr: A singing, happy drunk wanders around, singing about Moria.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.name: drunk

__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.description: The beggar looks like she is fed up with life.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.long_descr: A beggar is here, asking for a few coins.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.name: beggar

__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.description: The alley cat is half starved and more than a little feral.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.long_descr: An alley cat hisses at you.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.name: cat

__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.description: A big, strong, helpful, trustworthy guard.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.long_descr: A cityguard is here, guarding the gate.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.name: cityguard guard

__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.description: A big, strong, helpful, trustworthy guard.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.long_descr: A cityguard is here, guarding the gate.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.name: cityguard guard

__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.description: A big, strong, helpful, trustworthy guard.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.long_descr: A cityguard is here, guarding the mayor.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.name: cityguard guard

__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.description: He looks very dangerous.  I wouldn't try to rob him.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.long_descr:
An old man eyes you greedily.
The old man says, 'Would you like to buy a nice love potion?'
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.name: shopkeeper old man

__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.description: A big, strong, helpful, trustworthy guard.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.long_descr: A cityguard is here, guarding the gate alertly.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.name: cityguard guard

__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.description: A big, strong, helpful, trustworthy guard.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.long_descr: A cityguard is here, guarding the gate.  He is half asleep.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.name: cityguard guard

__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.description: The kitten looks like a cute, little, fierce fighter.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.long_descr: A small loyal kitten is here.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.name: kitten cat pet

__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.description: The puppy looks like a cute, little, fierce fighter.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.long_descr: A small loyal puppy is here.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.name: puppy dog pet

__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.description: The beagle looks like a fierce fighter.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.long_descr: A small, quick, loyal beagle is here.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.name: beagle dog pet

__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.description: The rottweiler looks like a strong, fierce fighter.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.long_descr: A large, loyal rottweiler is here.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.name: rottweiler dog pet

__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.description: The wolf looks like a strong, fearless fighter.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.long_descr: A large, trained wolf is here.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.name: wolf pet

__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.description: The eagle looks like a strong fierce fighter.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.long_descr: A loyal eagle circles overhead.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.name: eagle bird pet

__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.description: The great lion looks very fierce.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.long_descr: A large, faithful lion is here.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.name: lion pet

__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.description: The large, striped tiger looks like a savage fighter.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.long_descr: A great, loyal tiger is here.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.name: tiger pet

__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.description:
She is very beautiful with golden hair, and deep blue eyes. A good reason
for coming here more often.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.long_descr: The maid is waiting for your order.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.name: maid

__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.description: The sexton looks like he is relaxing after another grave-digging job.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.long_descr: A sexton is sitting here, drinking hot tea.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.name: sexton

__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.description: The white swan is very elegant.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.long_descr: A swan is swimming around in the pond.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.name: swan

__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.description: The duckling is adorable, it looks most of all like a tiny furball.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.long_descr: A duckling is swimming around in the pond.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.name: duckling

__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.description: The sparrow looks like it is enjoying life.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.long_descr: A sparrow is flapping around on the ground.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.name: sparrow

__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.description: The duck is quite fat.  It looks like it is enjoying life.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.long_descr: A duck is here, quacking happily.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.name: duck

__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.description: A big, strong, angry captain.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.long_descr: The captain of the guard is looking very upset.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.name: captain

__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.description: A big, strong, angry guard.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.long_descr: A cityguard stands here, looking very upset.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.name: cityguard guard

__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.description:
She looks very busy.
The Secretary says 'Sorry, but the Mayor is extremely busy today'.
The Secretary says 'Please sit down and have a seat in the meantime'.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.long_descr: A secretary is sitting at the desk.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.name: secretary

__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.description: He is a stocky, middle-aged man with thin, grey hair.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.long_descr: The mayor is here.  He shakes your hand.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.name: mayor

__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.description: He is very good at his job - completely dissolved in tears.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.long_descr: The town crier is here, weeping quietly.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.name: crier

__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.description:
Esme brushes a lock of dark hair away from her wire-rimmed glasess and
smiles warmly at you.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.long_descr: Esme the waitress hums to herself and wonders what you'd like to order.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.name: esme waitress

__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.description:
Ragged brown hair frames a ghostly, pale face.  Puffy eyelids surround two
sky blue, haunting eyes.  An old, brown robe is wrapped around her frail
frame.  She looks up from her pile of papers and maps and looks inquiringly
at you, smiling faintly.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.long_descr: Melancholy is here, digging through a pile of scrolls, papers, and maps.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.name: melancholy

__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.description:
This is Melancholy's pet tree snake, Lister.  Something seems odd about his
jaw, almost as if he were smiling at you.  He's quite friendly, but don't
get him drunk.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.long_descr: A green tree snake is sitting here on a pile of books.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.name: lister green tree snake

__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.description:
Otho is grotesquely fat man dressed in rich clothes.  Apparently the money
changing business pays quite well in this busy city, or possibly the rumors
of his fencing services are true...
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.long_descr: Otho the Money Changer sits behind his desk, waiting for your coins.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.name: otho money changer moneychanger

__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.description: Well COUNT your money!
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.long_descr: A thief, all dressed in black.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.name: thief
